name: Injection moulding
summary: Hot plastic is pushed into a steel mould under high pressure. The part cools, and the mould opens to release it.
how: Melt the plastic pellets in a heated barrel.
Press the melt into the closed mould.
Cool the part, open the mould and push the part out.

origin.note: John Wesley Hyatt patents a machine that presses hot celluloid into a mould.

adoptions.via: Moulded plastic forms the dashboard and the trim of the pony car.
Moulded plastic forms the dashboard and the black trim of the wedge.
The Swatch case and strap are moulded in plastic, so that the factory needs few parts and little hand work.
Large bumpers and panels are moulded in one piece and painted in the body colour.
Moulded plastic forms the smooth dash and the door cards.
